Resolves all adware dns requests on your network to a black hole. Its network level adblock so it even works with mobile apps

I got a raspberry pi, which is fairly inexpensive, and started running it after a friend recommended it. Has not been disruptive and it does block alot of ads.

Since your name requests from your devices are never resolved, the ads are never downloaded in the first place. A browser ad block downloads the ads and chooses not to display them. So this blocks ads in a different way than a browser based blocker.

I have been happy with it. The hardware is cheap and the software is free.

Pi-hole works for your whole network. It covers your computer, your laptop, your phone, your smart TV, and also works for any guests that visit.
I should have made it clear (I did not) that I use dnsmasq as a dns service for my local network.

you can also block all windows telemetry from windows 10.

and you can lock it down as far as you want.

the issue that i find is this is a device that you basically have to leave on 24/7 it sucks about 1amp an hour on your electric bill.

updating it is kind of a bitch to do it correctly as once a month you have to jack in a keyboard and a monitor to raspberry pie and then update it properly besides the pihole updates there are OS updates if you want to stay current.

the setup can also be a little insecure as the defaults for the OS are a little too open in my opinion as the openness allows easy installs.

most people will then leave it alone and not think to lock it down.

the pi-hole can cause issues with 3rd party software. cloud applications can experience failures as the pihole will be blocking incoming traffic.

even adding exclusion rules can continue to cause issues.

i've had the pi-hole also go a little nuts over time where suddenly the DNS is down or it shows up and refuses to connect.

you then have to reboot it. unplugging it and powering back on without a proper shutdown can sometimes cause the complete corruption of the OS and at that point you have to reinstall the entire thing as it is just easy then attempting to fix the second copy of the MBR over the first corrupted copy.

you basically have to switch constantly between your pi-hole and normal to get work done unless you just plan on browsing.

when using the pihole to block content to a smart TV it basically breaks the smart tv apps and if you want to watch some streaming content you have to turn it off.
